renovation.title: Plastic injection machine renovation
renovation.subtitle: Electrical retrofit, PLC, HMI and full commissioning of your injection machines.
renovation.intro: An older injection machine, even in good mechanical condition, quickly becomes a production bottleneck once its control system is obsolete. Renovation modernizes the electrical cabinet, control and safety of the machine, without replacing the still-functional hydraulic and mechanical assembly.
items: Full diagnostics of the existing electrical installation
Replacement of the electrical cabinet and outdated wiring
Integration of a modern PLC and HMI interface
Replacement or tuning of drives and servo systems

automation.subtitle: PLC programming, HMI, drives and integration of modern control systems.
automation.intro: Industrial automation improves the precision, repeatability and safety of your production equipment. It applies to injection machines as well as other industrial equipment requiring automated control.
items: Design of clear, functional HMI interfaces
Installation and calibration of industrial sensors

maintenance.intro: Unplanned production downtime has a direct cost on your business. Our troubleshooting approach favors precise diagnostics before any intervention, to identify the actual cause of the failure rather than replacing parts at random.

faqItems.q: Can you inspect a machine before purchase?
faqItems.a: Yes, a technical inspection can be arranged before purchase, on request, to verify the machine's actual condition.

faqItems.q: How do I request a specific machine?
faqItems.a: Use the "I'm looking for a machine" form, specifying tonnage, brand, budget and desired condition. We then search our network.

faqItems.q: How do I get a quote?
faqItems.a: Contact us via WhatsApp, phone or the contact form describing your need. We'll get back to you with a clear proposal.

faqItems.q: What types of machines do you handle?
faqItems.a: Mainly hydraulic, servo or hybrid plastic injection machines, as well as related automation equipment.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.subtitle: How Jimi Renovation & Installation collects, uses and protects your personal data.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body: We collect the information you voluntarily provide: through the site's forms (name, phone, email, company, request details), through WhatsApp (your number and the content of your messages, including photos you send us to identify a machine, a part, or a fault), or by phone/email.

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.body: Your data is used only to process your request: to contact you back, prepare a quote, arrange an intervention, or finalize the purchase or sale of a machine. We never use it for unsolicited advertising and never sell it to third parties.

sections.heading: WhatsApp assistant and artificial intelligence
sections.body: Our WhatsApp button may be connected to an automated assistant that replies on our behalf when we are unavailable. This assistant relies on Anthropic's Claude API to understand and respond to your messages: the content of your conversation is sent to this provider to generate a reply, for that purpose only. A member of our team can take over the conversation at any time, and the assistant never provides a price, delay, or information that hasn't been confirmed by our team.

sections.heading: Sharing with technical providers
sections.body: To run the site and our services, we use technical providers who may process your data on our behalf: Meta (WhatsApp Business Platform) for messaging, Google Firebase for secure storage of requests, Cloudinary for hosting photos and videos, and Anthropic for the AI assistant described above. None of these providers is authorized to use your data for any purpose other than the one we've engaged them for.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We keep your data for as long as necessary to process your request and provide commercial follow-up (warranty, after-sales service). You may request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may at any time request to access, correct, or delete the data we hold about you by writing to the address below.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any question about this privacy policy or your personal data, contact us at aminedjimi20@gmail.com or via WhatsApp.
